Makeup by Mon — logo identity for Monikaa, makeup artist (2019).

A monogram exploration that worked a single 'M' a dozen ways — ornate vintage frames, winged circles, geometric line-monograms — before resolving to a confident olive-and-gold mark with a hand-script 'Makeup Stories by Mon.' The whole point of an exploration: earning the final mark by drawing all the others first.

Logo identity — Anirudh Kapoor. A·63.
